descriptor_docs.body: Shell weight at 190-530 Hz relative to the 0.5-2 kHz mids.
descriptor_docs.crack: Wire-band attack-to-body contrast at 2-8 kHz. Higher means a harder initial snap.
descriptor_docs.snap: Wire rattle against shell tone over the first ~140 ms. High = wires wide open, low = muted / tuned-down thud.
descriptor_docs.bright: Wire-body brightness at 3.7-13 kHz, after the initial stick crack.
descriptor_docs.decay: Energy-weighted duration in milliseconds across shell and wires. Higher means longer sustain.
